scoring_justification: T1 recompute infeasible because the checker cannot rerun the full MD simulation; scoring structural trends in the submitted parameter table.

hidden_assets.purpose: structural thresholds for oscillator parameter trends (transition energy, damping threshold, mass ratio bounds)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: derived from the paper's reported trends and values in Fig.3 and text
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted key structural constraints from the paper: transition total energy -5.444e-14 erg/atom, damping coefficient near zero below transition, mass ratio ~12 below and ~1 above, spring constant increasing above transition.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the paper's reported qualitative behaviors, used as checkable structural rules, not fabricated values.

outputs.description: Oscillator parameters extracted from MD simulations as a function of total energy. Used to verify the structural trends and the transition energy marking the onset of single-particle excitations and damping.

output_contract.notes: The transition total energy is expected around -5.444×10⁻¹⁴ erg/atom. The damping coefficient should be near zero below this energy and increase linearly above; period changes slope; spring constant increases as √E above; reduced mass ratio drops from ~12 to ~1. Tolerances are not disclosed.
